Commentary.Commentary: So what will be on South Africa's mind? No target as such. The first aim will be to see off today, then maybe bat till the final hour of tomorrow and declare with a target of around 600. Stay tuned for their second innings.

Easier said than done, but the visitors must not lose hope. Very recently, in Brisbane, there was an inspiring story. Even though they could not make it, Pakistan almost crossed the finish line chasing a target of 490. If the Islanders can muster their courage, keep a calm head above their shoulders, then something can be made of this.

Pressure will be on the Lankans. But the advantage on their side is that fact that they will have a warmer track to bowl on. With the forecast for the remaining days clear and the sun shining out like it has, they should have a better chance of pulling something off.

South Africa will be quite happy with how they've done so far. Things have gone according to plan, the players have come to the fore and executed everything to perfection. It was a collective performance which will please skipper Faf du Plessis more than anything.

Excellent bowling display from the South Africans. Rabada set things up, with a 4-fer, then Philander came back towards the end to mop up the tail with a 4-fer of his own. Keshav Maharaj chipped in with a couple of wickets while Kyle Abbott was extremely frugal, going for just 9 in his 8 overs.

The conditions are not overcast. The ball is not moving like a banana. There is no prodigious seam movement. But still, Sri Lanka have not even made one-third of the Protea total and not lasted even the maximum allotted overs in an ODI. One rash shot while the others were indecisive. Not sure whether to play or not and got sent back to the pavillion.

When a batting side has been dismissed for 110, it becomes extremely difficult to summarize its innings. The top 3 started well, seeing off the new ball, showing off some resistance and were 56/1 just a few overs before Tea. But then a rash shot from Kusal Mendis led to a collapse and they lost their last 9 wickets for just 54 runs.

BIG NEWS and a surprising one - SOUTH AFRICA ARE BATTING AGAIN. A bit baffling, to be honest. One would have though that Faf du Plessis would have liked to have a go at the Lankans this evening, with around three quarters of an hour left. But, he feels his bowlers need rest.

OUT! A TERIFFIC DISPLAY OF SEAM BOWLING and he has figures of 12-4-27-4 to boast of! Bowls it on a length outside off, moves away slightly after pitching. Pradeep hangs his bat at it but gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Faf du Plessis at second slip. He makes no mistake and pouches it safely. Absolutely cracking performance with the ball from the home side and they have bowled the Lankans out for 110!
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in.

OUT! WHAT WAS KUMARA DOING THERE? Philander gets his third. Kumara was guilty of leaving a fullish ball attacking the stumps and he pays the price for it. He had absolutely no clue about that and looks back to see his leg stump shattered. Watching Philander bowl has been a joy to watch today. They still have 83 to avoid the follow-on which seems on the cards. Will South Africa have a crack at the visitors again?
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Upul works it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
On a length and angling in, Tharanga defends it to the leg side.
He gets a bit cramped up but manages to defend the length delivery off his back foot.
FOUR! SHOT! Shortish delivery angling in, Tharanga stands tall and pulls it hard through mid-wicket and earns a boundary to his name.
FOUR! HE IS CARRYING HIS CONFIDENCE FROM HIS BOWLING! Tosses it up on the stumps, Kumara clears his front leg and tonks it over mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Kneels and sweeps it uppishly with the spin through square leg for a run.
Quicker and flatter again on the stumps, Tharanga blocks it into the ground.
A touch quicker around off, defended to the off side from the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up around off, defended with the spin to short leg.
Goes right back in his crease and blocks.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The hero with the ball in the first innings, LAHIRU KUMARA walks in at number 10, replacing Lakmal.

EDGED, DROPPED, CAUGHT, OUT! Philander has his second. Full and outside off, Lakmal pushes at it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies thick and fast to Dean Elgar at third slip who gets down to catch it over his head but the ball bursts through his palms. Luckily for him, the ball does not go too far and lobs in the it towards first slip where Hashim Amla takes it calmly. 150 TEST WICKETS FOR PHILANDER! Still a long time left in the day. Will the Proteas enforce the follow-on?
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Full and outside off, Lakmal comes forward to defend it towards mid off.
SURANGA LAKMAL walks in at number 9, replacing Herath.

OUT! LBW! Philander gets his man. On a good length outside off, this one nips back in as well, Herath misses his flick and is hit on the pads. He appeals and appeals and eventually umpire Dar raises his finger. Herath takes the review but Hawk Eye shows the ball to be clipping the top of leg stump. So umpire's call stays. 7 wickets down, 93 RUNS MORE NEEDED TO AVOID THE FOLLOW-ON.
Another UDRS incident. Rangana Herath has been adjudged LBW and he wants to review.
Plenty of flight outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
On middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Around off, kept out watchfully.

FOUR! MAJESTIC! A little overpitched outside off, Tharanga leans, opens the face of the bat and drives it through point for a boundary. 100 UP FOR SRI LANKA! This stand is worth 22 from 41 balls. Tharanga himself has reached 20 from 28 balls with 4 boundaries.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and outside off, Tharanga defends it back to the bowler.

And again. Another LBW appeal. Nips this back a long way from outside off, Rangana misses his flick again and is hit on the pads. The umpire turns it down again and Faf contemplates about the review but does not take it. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be clipping leg stump, so umpire's call would have stayed.

Comes back in from around the wicket, angles this down the leg side, Herath misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Philander appeals for LBW but umpire Aleem Dar turns it down. Going down the leg side.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Tharanga gets on top of the bounce and cuts it behind point for a boundary. 98 more needed to avoid the follow-on now.

Full on middle, Tharanga drives it straight back. Philander gets his hands down and deflects it back onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. He starts to appeal for the run out but then realizes that Herath is in.
Goes back in his crease and blocks.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! Full and outside off, Tharanga looks to play the slog sweep but gets a top edge. JP Duminy runs after it from mid-wicket but can get to it only after it bounces. A single taken.
Down the leg side, Herath looks to flick but the ball hits his pads and goes past short leg. A leg bye taken.
Landed outside off, left alone.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! Full and outside off, Tharanga leans and drives it through mid off for a boundary!
Outside off, left alone.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Goes back in his crease and defends.
VERNON PHILANDER comes back on.
Full and down the leg side, swept uppishly through square leg for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and outside off, nudged fine, just wide of Temba Bavuma at short leg. A single taken.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Stays back and defends.
EDGED, FOUR! Full and outside off, Tharanga pushes hard and gets a thick outside edge which flies past second slip to third man.
A bouncer on middle and off, Tharanga ducks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around middle, Herath looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge behind square leg.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and pushes it to long on. Mid on dives to his right and prevents the boundary. A single taken.

INSIDE EDGE. ALMOST A BAT-PAD CATCH. Full and outside off, Tharanga prods forward to defend. The ball bounces, hits the face of the bat and pops out in the air but well wide of short leg. May be, may be, a silly point might have taken it, had he been in place, but still, would have been very difficult.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, left alone. Rabada's figures read 11-2-33-4.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.

RANGANA HERATH walks in at number 8, replacing Chandimal. One of my colleagues is confident that the Lankans will come out to bat for their second innings tonight itself. C'mon mate, let us show them some respect.

OUT! Caught behind! A procession is going on out there. Frustrating batting from the Sri Lankans. This is not a one-day international, it is a Test match, says Michael Holding on air. You are allowed to let those balls go outside off stump. But the batsmen do not seem to agree. Full and wide outside off, Chandimal goes hard with the cover drive, but his feet are stuck in the crease. Gets a thick outside edge to de Kock who snaffles it. Wicket number 4 for Rabada. Still 115 MORE NEEDED to avoid the follow-on.
Struggles with that wind blowing behind him and sprays this down the leg side, Chandimal cannot get it away with a pull.
On a good length again, well outside off, Dinesh shoulders arms.
On a good length outside off, Chandimal pushes it to cover and sets off for a single coming halfway down the track but Tharanga sends him back. There was no single there.
UPUL THARANGA walks in at number 7, replacing de Silva.

OUT! LBW! Maharaj has his second. Flighted around off, de Silva comes down the track and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. He is hit very low, so in spite of jumping out of the crease, the height is not a factor. Only the impact is the question and Hawk Eye shows that to be UMPIRE'S CALL, so the decision stays. The ball was going on to hit the stumps.
UDRS TIME AGAIN! This time from Sri Lanka. Dhananjaya de Silva has been adjudged LBW but he wants a re-look.
Outside off, slower in pace, defended from the crease.

FOUR! De Silva is slowly turning it on here. Might as well get some runs and make the scoreboard moving because the batsmen have just been defending, consuming balls and then walking back to the pavilion. Fractionally short outside off, de Silva goes back and cuts it through point for a boundary. Poor delivery and put away.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Short and down the leg side, tucked through square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Nice use of the feet. Tossed up on middle and leg, de Silva dances down the track and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The stand moves to 12 from 17 balls. De Silva moves to 10 from 17 balls.
Another bouncer, Chandimal ducks.
A bouncer to test the batsman's footwork, ducked under.

Banged in short, at the body, Dhananjaya pulls it towards fine leg but Stephen Cook at leg gully sticks out his left hand and takes some sting off the ball. Just a single taken when it could have well been a boundary.
Full and outside off, de Silva leans and drives it through the covers for a couple.
This is just around off, defended tightly.
This is full and wide outside off, hint of away swing, left alone.
The arm ball on middle and off, Chandimal comes forward to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball lobs in the air but drops short of silly point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully kept out.
Down the leg side, tucked just wide of short leg for a single.
A quicker ball around middle, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, de Silva comes down the track and whips it to mid on.
FOUR! That is just a push! Full and outside off, Chandimal comes forward and only puts bat to ball. It races to the cover fence. 129 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
Landed outside off, allowed to go through as Chandimal shoulders arms.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
DINESH CHANDIMAL walks in at number 6, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Catching practice! On a good length outside off, comes back in, bounces a bit extra, Mathews fends at it and hands an easy catch off the outside edge to his counterpart Faf du Plessis at second slip. One skipper smiles while the other walks back with a forlorn face. 133 MORE NEEDED TO AVOID THE FOLLOW-ON.
On a good length around middle and off, defended awkwardly.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Landed outside off, a touch short, defended watchfully.
Comes down the track and defends.
Slows this up outside off, not much flight, Mathews comes forward and dead-bats it.
Full on middle, nicely tossed up, driven towards mid on.

NOT OUT. A poor review in the end, especially when Faf himself was not sure. On a good length around middle, angling down, de Silva hops to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Rabada appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Faf asks the question to his players - Rabada has a quizzing look of a child whether he wants a chocolate or a lollypop while Quinton de Kock does not want to take the review. Then, like a parent not wanting to break his child's heart, Faf goes for the review, albeit he himself indicates that it might be going down the leg side. Replays show that Rabada nearly overstepped but was fine in the end. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be missing leg stump. So neither a chocolate nor the lollypop, just a waste of a review.
REVIEW TIME. South Africa are not entirely sure whether they have their batsman but Faf du Plessis has taken the review.
Another one sprayed down the leg side, Dhananjaya tries flicking but misses. Quinton de Kock flies to his left like a goalkeeper and stops the ball.

Slips this down the leg side again, de Silva lets it through. Alviro Petersen on air mentions that the end from which Kagiso Rabada is bowling, the wind is blowing behind him. So the ball tends to go down the leg side, which is why Rabada is struggling to maintain his line.
A bouncer on middle and off, Silva ducks.
Works this down the leg side for a couple.
Full and outside off, left alone.
Outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Fullish again, just around middle, well kept out.
Goes back and defends.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around middle and leg, watchfully defended.
KESHAV MAHARAJ will continue from the other end.
Homing in on middle and leg, it's clipped down towards fine leg for an easy single.
Makes another watchful leave. Covers the line well and lets the length ball through.
Good length delivery in that off stump channel, Mathews with a solid leave. Raises his bat and lets it through.
ANGELO MATHEWS, the Sri Lankan skipper, is the next batsman in.

OUT! Rabada strikes immediately and takes his 50TH TEST WICKET! And it's Temba Bavuma, to nobody's surprise, with a brilliant catch. Short and wide outside off, Karunaratne flashes at this and flashes hard. It's in the air and flies straight towards point where Bavuma dives low to his left and takes a brilliant catch. Sri Lanka's set batsman is back in the dressing room. South Africa have two fresh batsmen out in the crease now to bowl at. They must be licking their lips at this.
Closer to the off stump, on a length, Karunaratne with a solid back foot defense.
Rabada from around the wicket, fires in a full ball well outside off, it's left alone.
We are back for the last session of Day 2. Dimuth Karunaratne and Dhananjaya de Silva will continue the Sri Lankan innings. Kagiso Rabada to start the bowling proceedings....
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

The bowling has been relentless. The ball has not been moving much but the Protean bowling attack has kept the runs tight. So far, Karunaratne has exhibited a wonderful amount of patience. But where will the runs come from? Dhananjaya de Silva is not a blocker and he certainly likes to get things going. Will that pave the door open for the home side? 40 overs left in the day. Join us back at 1900 IST (1330 GMT).

After getting close to 400 with the bat, the home side started their defense well, bowling tight lines and lengths. They gave nothing away but the Lankan openers were firm. They managed to see off the first hour but then Silva dragged one on. Later, Karunaratne and Mendis continued their defensive approach till impatience got the better of the latter.

A slow session which goes in South Africa's favour. Would have been balanced had Mendis not played that shot to get out. It has been pressure, pressure, pressure built up by the Proteas and eventually, something gave.
Quicker ball, on middle and leg, worked to the leg side. TEA ON DAY 2, SRI LANKA TRAIL BY 336!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers where Duminy dives to his left to stop the ball.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA has been promoted to number 4, replacing Mendis.

OUT! Caught! Mendis loses his focus and pays the price. Full and outside off, Mendis looks to play the slog sweep but he is early into the same. Gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. JP Duminy comes in from short extra cover and takes it near the bowler. Maharaj roars in anger. Poor choice of a shot with Tea around the corner. SRI LANKA NEED ANOTHER 137 TO AVOID THE FOLLOW-ON.
Landed outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Karunaratne drives it towards long on for a single.
Short of a length, just around off, Kusal Mendis once again gets across and works it to the right of mid on.
Back of a length rising off the deck outside off, Mendis stands tall and dabs it towards the point region.
Switches angles and comes from over the wicket now, pounds in a short one to take Mendis by surprise. Kusal however does well to go across, hop and keep it down on the track.
Angling in on the pads, it's flicked away towards mid-wicket and the batsmen take a single.
Another one on a fuller length, outside off, it's driven to the cover region for nothing.
Fires this full on the stumps, it's driven to the mid on region by Dimuth Karunaratne.
Stays right behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out to end the over.
Looped just outside off, some dip on that occasion as well, it's driven to covers. No run taken.

SIX! Take a bow, Kusal Mendis! What a hit, son. It's tossed up on middle and off, Mendis adjusts himself, gets low and slog sweeps it right off the meat of the bat. Connects well and sends it comfortably over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Gives this one a bit of flight and still attacks the stumps, once again it's worked to mid-wicket with a closed face.
Another flatter ball, on the stumps, worked to mid-wicket with a closed face.
Drifting in on middle and leg, it's driven to mid on for no run.
Time for spin. KESHAV MAHARAJ into the attack now.
Another bouncer, ducked under this time.
FIVE WIDES! A short ball, around middle, Karunaratne ducks. The ball flies too high and Quinton de Kock leaps but cannot stop it. Into the fence she goes.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Again he strays down the leg side, this time from over the wicket, Mendis helps it towards fine leg for a run. The deficit is now 349.
Strays down the leg side with the angle, Karunaratne helps it through square leg for a single.
Another solid defense on offer.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
KAGISO RABADA comes back on.
Maintains that line outside off, watchfully blocked out.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, KM pushes it through point where the fielder dives to his left but does not make a clean stop. He fumbles but the batsmen do not run.
Down the leg side, Kusal cannot get it away.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.

FOUR! Short and down the leg side, Mendis looks to pull but does not hit it that convincingly. However, he gets enough bat on it to pull it past the keeper to the fine leg fence. The stand moves to 10. Mendis is finally off the mark on his 13th ball.

FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! Full and outside off, Karunaratne leans and drives it beautifully through the covers. Uppish but in the yawning gap between mid off and point for a boundary. Moves to 21 with his third boundary.
On a good length outside off, Karunaratne pushes at it but the ball straightens a touch and beats the outside edge.
Full and straight, tucked towards short mid-wicket.
Much fuller, but no movement, just coming in with the angle, defended towards mid on again.
Comes back in but not as much as the previous one. Calmly defended towards mid on.
On a good length outside off, left alone. That came back in a long way and had the slip cordon excited.
This is around off, watchfully defended. End of an excellent over. Looked like Philander almost worked out Mendis there.
Asking questions, is Philander. On a good length outside off, KM looks to defend but then gets squared up as the ball moves away. Gets an outside edge which lands short of the slip cordon.

Hmmm.... things are happening now. Very full and straight, a little bit slower, Kusal plays a bit early and chips it uppishly but wide of the bowler towards mid on where Kagiso Rabada makes a sliding stop to his left.
Terrific delivery. The previous ball was slightly short and moved away while this one was just short of a fuller length and came back in, right at the stumps. Mendis was watchful to keep it out.
Landed outside off, Mendis plays at it without moving his feet, then realizes that he is too far from the ball and tries to withdraw his bat but is late and gets beaten.
On a good length on middle, angling down, tucked towards fine leg for a single. 160 more needed to avoid the follow-on.
VERNON PHILANDER comes back on to bowl.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and off, pushed towards mid on.
Landed outside off, short in length, Mendis looks to steer it to third man but gets a bottom edge to second slip.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

Outside off, Karunaratne pushes it towards point and sets off. There is a slight miscommunication between the two batsmen. Karunaratne wants the run, but Mendis doesn't. Then he respects the striker's call and runs. In the meanwhile, JP Duminy gets across from point and fumbles, allowing the single. The two batsmen then shout at each other as neither is able to hear the other due to the strong wind. A series of "HAAAN?" "HAAN?" "HAAN?" follows till both have the common sense to walk to the middle and have a softer chat.

A slight issue here. A cool breeze is blowing across but it is a bit sturdy and the bails on the stumps at the striker's end fall off. The square leg umpire runs across, keeps them back and runs to his position again.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven to the covers.
Bowls it fullish and it's down the leg side, Mendis looks to glance it but misses.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Camps back to this one and defends it nicely.
KUSAL MENDIS comes in at No. 3.

OUT! RABADA STRIKES! Silva's uncomfortable stay at the crease comes to an end. Bowls a short of a length delivery on off, Silva hops back, gets into a bit of an awkward position and looks to defend it but gets an inside edge rather. The ball goes back and crashes into the stumps. Rabada has been rewarded for bowling disciplined lines and lengths. End of a stubborn 31-run stand.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Slips this one down the leg side, Silva looks to play at it but misses.
In the channel outside off, Karunaratne pushes at it tamely but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish delivery around off, defended solidly off the back foot.

Short of a length ball outside off, Dimuth feels for it but gets beaten. There have been a lot of plays and misses by the Sri Lankan openers. The South Africans would be disappointed not to get a breakthrough.
Short of a length ball angling in, Karunaratne camps back and defends it nicely.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fullish delivery outside off, Silva prods forward and pushes it to the covers.
On a length outside off, Silva dabs it towards the slip cordon.
Dug in short and it's going down the leg side, Silva ducks underneath it.
Fullish and straying on the pads, clipped to the on side for a run.
Bowls a short of a length ball on off, tucked to the leg side.
Fullish delivery outside off, pushed to the covers.

Leg Bye! Comes from around the wicket and strays it on the hips, Karunaratne looks to tuck it but the ball brushes his thigh pad and rolls towards backward square leg. Single taken and they look for the second but it is not on.
Length delivery outside off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length and on the stumps, clipped towards mid-wicket.
On a length slanting across the southpaw. He camps back and plays it with an angled blade towards gully.
Bowls a length delivery outside off, angling away. Dimuth shoulders his arms to let that one through.
Change of ends for KYLE ABBOTT.
Time for Drinks.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line. Kaushal lets it go.

He is getting his deliveries to curve back sharply and keeping the batsmen on their toes. This time Silva plants his front foot across and shoulders his arms to leave the inward shaping delivery alone.
Slips this one down the leg side, Silva looks to clip it but misses.
Straying on the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
Hurls in a short of a length delivery, Dimuth rides the bounce and defends it down.
GOOD GAME AWARENESS! Angles in a fullish delivery into Silva. He prods forward and pushes it to the covers. Scurries through for a sharp single.
Full delivery on off, pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
BRAVE LEAVE! Bowls it in the channel outside off, shapes back a touch after landing. Karunaratne covers his off pole and allows it through safely.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length on middle and off, Dimuth covers the line and defends it down the track.
Back of a length ball into the stumps, Karunaratne camps back and defends it to the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! LUCKY RUNS! Bowls a length ball outside off, Silva goes for an ambitious drive on the up but gets a thick outside edge that flies towards the man at third slip. He leaps high in the air but the ball eludes him and runs down to the third man fence.
Back of a length delivery, gets a bit big on Silva. He looks to defend it but gets it from the shoulder of his bat to the off side.
On a length on the stumps, played through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! SHOT! Bowls a short delivery outside off and there is room on offer, Karunaratne frees his arms and slashes it uppishly through third man and the ball races to the fence.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, Silva creams it through the covers and will get three good runs for it.
KAGISO RABADA comes into the attack.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fuller length ball on off, Dimuth looks to defend it off his front foot but is hit on the pads.
Bowls a length delivery down the leg side, Dimuth looks to work it across but misses and the ball kisses his pads and de Kock behind the stumps pouches it.
Shortish delivery outside off, Karunaratne looks to cut it but gets it off the inner half and the ball drops on the pitch and bounces past the stumps.
Short of a length delivery, Dimuth punches it towards mid off.
Fullish delivery swinging down towards the pads, Dimuth looks to clip it away but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Dug in short this time, Silva ducks under it.
Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, shaping away after pitching. Silva plays at it but gets beaten comprehensively.
Camps back to this one and defends it.

BRILLIANT EFFORT FROM TEMBA BAVUMA! Karunaratne camps back to the length ball and taps it with soft hands towards covers. Sets off immediately for a run. Bavuma hares across from point, picks it up and hurls in a direct hit at the non striker's end. Karunaratne dives in to get back but has he made his crease? Yes, he has as the replays show that the full length dive saved him there and the big screen confirms NOT OUT.
A run out appeal against Karunaratne is referred upstairs. Looked pretty close and the South Africans are chirpy.
Prods forward to the full delivery on off and defends it calmly.
Bowls a length ball on off, Karunaratne camps back and defends it solidly down the track.
Fullish delivery outside off, shapes away a touch. Silva pokes at it tentatively but gets beaten.
Length delivery outside off, zips through the pitch. Silva is surprised by the bounce and gets an edge that falls safely towards the slip cordon.
Length delivery, shaping back in. Silva lunges forward and defends it.

Comes forward to the fullish delivery and pushes it to the covers. Mike Haysman on air, points out that Silva has made an adjustment to his technique. He was moving a long way across in the first Test but he is much more settled at the crease here.
Bowls a full delivery on off, Karunaratne pushes it gently off his front foot and takes a brisk single.
On a length on leg stump, clipped past short leg.
Stays back to this one and defends it solidly.
On a length outside off, angling away. Silva comes forward and looks to defend it but gets an outside edge towards gully. He played that with soft hands.
Leg bye! Straying on the hips, Karunaratne looks to clip it but misses and the ball brushes his thigh pad and rolls towards short fine leg. Leg bye taken!
Fullish delivery, played with soft hands to the on side for a run.

Bowls it on a fuller length on off, Silva clips it with soft hands to the left of the fielder at short leg and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to get out off his blocks but isn't able to collect it. If he hurled a throw at the non-striker's end it could have been a close call.
Bowls a short of a length delivery well outside off, Silva points his bat skywards and allows it through.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Continues with his fullish length and bowls it on the stumps, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length outside off, swinging away. Left alone.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Karunaratne tries to dead-bat it but gets it high on the bat. The ball spoons down the pitch but is far away from the reach of Philander on his followthrough.

FOUR! STREAK BOUNDARY! Bowls a short and wide delivery outside off, Dimuth slashes at it and the ball flies over the slip cordon and runs down to the third man boundary. He was not in control of that shot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish ball outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

HE IS LIVING DANGEROUSLY HERE! On a length, tailing back in. Kaushal comes forward to counter it but is hit on the gloves and the ball falls down on the pitch. That was not far from the short leg fielder.
Down the leg side, Silva looks to play it but misses.
Bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Silva hops back, looks to play at it initially but pulls his bat out at the last moment.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Bowls a fullish delivery, Dimuth drives it uppishly back towards Philander. It went on the bounce to him. Nervy moments for him!
THAT'S A PEACH OF A DELIVERY! Lands it on a length outside off, Karunaratne prods forward to defend but the away shape beats him all ends up.
Ooh.. That was close! Bowls it fullish on the stumps, swinging back. Karunaratne clips it uppishly just wide of the fielder at short leg. Two runs taken!
No ball! Wider and fullish outside off, Karunaratne lets it through. Philander overstepped on that occasion.
Full length ball outside off, left alone.
Field change. Short leg comes in place.
Bowls a fullish delivery on off, swirling in a touch, Dimuth looks to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards short mid-wicket.
Similar length delivery, curving away a touch. Silva lets it go. Good probing over by Abbott comes to an end.
Fullish delivery outside off, Silva doesn't flirt with that one.
Fullish delivery tailing back in, Kaushal looks to clip it but ends up gloving it down the track.
He is bowling a great channel here. Continues to land it in the corridor of uncertainty. Silva feels for it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
BEAUTIFULLY BOWLED! Bowls a length delivery outside off, Silva has no choice but to play at it but is beaten by the away swing.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
KYLE ABBOTT to bowl from the other end.
Two Leg Byes! Straying on the hips, Dimuth looks to clip it but the ball brushes his pads and runs down to fine leg. Rabada does the tidying up job and keeps them down to two.
Lands this on a length outside off, straightens a touch after pitching. A watchful leave by the batsman.
Slips this one down the leg side, swinging further down. Karunaratne looks to cash on it but misses his flick.
THAT'S A PEACH! Bowls a fullish delivery on off, shapes away sharply. Dimuth is drawn into the drive but the ball beats him all ends up.
This time he gets it closer to the off pole. Karunaratne covers his off pole and allows it through.
Starts off with a short and wide delivery outside off, doesn't get his channel right. Karunaratne points his bat skywards and allows it through.
